entities.name: SSH3 (Q8TE77)
observations: Provided 659-aa sequence exactly matches reviewed human Slingshot homolog 3 Q8TE77 (100% identity and coverage).
Annotated protein phosphatase; possible role in actin dynamics and cofilin dephosphorylation is stated by similarity.
Mapped catalytic reactions include hydrolysis of phosphotyrosyl, phosphoseryl, and phosphothreonyl groups on proteins.

entities.name: Protein phosphoester hydrolysis
observations: General reaction: O-phospho amino acid residue in a protein + H2O → dephosphorylated protein residue + inorganic phosphate; mapped for phosphotyrosine (Rhea:10684), phosphoserine (Rhea:20629), and phosphothreonine (Rhea:47004).
